player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaiwhaiwha {player_id} i JoJoJoin, kei te tākaro ki runga i te papatohu 5x5 ki ngā poraka kua numera 0-24.
I tō wā, whakapumau tō tohu ki runga i te poraka kore, hei tauira '[12]'.
KOA IA KOE ina whai tohu whā o ō tohu i te rārangi — whā poraka i a tata, waenganui, ki waenganui rānei.
Heoi, ko koe te Kaiwhaiwha {player_id} ko koe '{symbol}'; ko tō hoariri ko '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kāore te nekehanga i tukuna e whai ana ki te hōputu tika.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} ehara i te pūtau whaimana. Me noho ki waenganui 0 me 24.

game_action.placed: Kaiwhaiwha {player_id} i whakapumau i to rātou tohu ({symbol}) ki roto i te poraka {cell}.
